reason: The preferred specification (pre-period controls, with the post-treatment collab_index_2023 excluded) reproduces exactly. It gives -0.275 (SE 0.24) and holds up with nonlinear and interaction controls, so "no detectable effect" is a fair reading. The one subgroup difference I found (founder-led firms, interaction p≈0.025) is a single exploratory test among several and doesn't survive multiple-comparison correction. The report also states its causal caveats and lists all 9 specifications.
